notes: Rebinding a hotkey works again: a new binding was only saved as a string - the hotkeys were registered once at startup and never again, so the meter kept answering to the old combination until it was restarted. The pause key was worse: the meter window and the global hotkey kept the same binding under one name in two different formats, and the one written last could not be read back, so after every restart pause fell back to Ctrl+Q whatever you had chosen. A combination another application already holds is refused by Windows - silent before, now the button turns red and says so; keys the settings screen can record but the parser did not understand (PgUp, punctuation, the numpad) no longer revert to the default; and the screen no longer claims defaults it does not have. After entering a dungeon the meter often could not tell which row was yours: it showed the raw entity id instead of your character name and saved the fight to history that way - the first two bosses of every run went in like that, and your name appeared only from the third one on. Fight data deliberately survives a zone change so that a boss you pull again keeps its numbers, but the test for "is the bound owner still fighting?" counted that leftover damage, so an id stranded in the previous run read as alive for the whole of the next one and every path that re-anchors the owner switched itself off - including the diagnostic that exists to report it. Two smaller holes on the same path were closed with it: your buff bar arrives in one burst at zone entry, seconds before your first hit, so the single attempt it got was spent before that entity had done anything; and when your own name reappeared on your new entity it was mistaken for a party member's name landing on your row. A Cleric party buff no longer counts as a debuff: buff/debuff classification now comes from the client for 682 more effects, 228 of which were being guessed from the whole skill family - which is why Earth's Blessing showed up among player debuffs. From the 25 August client patch: 27 new skill names (Ranger Deadshot, Cleric Earth's Blessing, Chanter Spinning Strike, Fighter Ferocity and Pulverize, Judgment), 9 buff names and icons, 6 wings and 4 creatures - a creature the meter does not know contributes nothing to your pet bonuses - and seven corrected NPC names.
